summary: Lower a private instance field to a C# private field only when receivers are statically proven branded instances created through the normal translated construction path.

target.notes: Emit a C# private field and rewrite same-class private accesses directly. Preserve initialization timing using the class-field ordering rules.

caveats: JavaScript private fields are based on private brands, not merely nominal visibility.
Unusual derived constructors can stamp private elements onto replacement objects; that case is excluded.

tests.name: private field read/write
tests.input: class C { #x=1; inc(){ this.#x++; return this.#x; } } console.log(new C().inc());
tests.expected_csharp: private double _x; public double inc(){ _x++; return _x; }

tests.name: edge: arbitrary receiver excludes native brand elision
tests.input: class C { #x=1; static read(o){ return o.#x; } } C.read({});
tests.expected_behavior: throws TypeError; direct field access is safe only when o is statically proven branded
